An ongoing TG story published in a bi-weekly strip format by the author who formerly used the "Atomics" nickname, and now goes with variations of "Robin Harper Comics" or "RHComics" depending on where they post.

Author's Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/RobinHarper
Also available on Webtoon: https://www.webtoons.com/en/challenge/being-fiona/list?title_no=802815
Also available on its own website: https://beingfiona.com/

The website and Webtoon have SFW variants of the NSFW red strips which are shown here.

The torrent includes all SFW and NSFW variants, also in vertical format, and as individual panels. The torrent is not zipped so you can download individual files if you want.

This comic is also available with strips reworked in a book format:
- Issue 1: https://e-hentai.org/g/3083467/de1e40238a/
